summary: Genmab A/S filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its interim report for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, a quarterly earnings release rather than a special-situation event. Revenue rose 22% to $3,238 million on higher DARZALEX and Kesimpta royalties and EPKINLY sales of $491 million; operating profit was $986 million. Disclosed Merus integration charges of $87 million reference a previously completed acquisition, not a new transaction. No stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock is stated. Watch quarterly launch trajectory for Rina-S and petosemtamab.
